# SCTransform

```{r}
so <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "so_immune_b.rds"), 
  function() {
    run_seurat_rna_workflow(
      so,
      run_SCT = TRUE,
      resolutions = seq(0.1, 1, 0.1),
      dims = 1:30
    ) 
  }
)
```


```{r}
metadata_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so)
```

## Clustering Analysis

```{r, fig.asp = 1}
#| fig-asp: 1

metadata_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-SCT_snn_res.1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "SCT_snn_res")) %>%
  plot_umap(color_str = "value", pointsize = 2.1) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = value),
    data = ~ ..1 %>%
      group_by(name, value) %>%
      summarise(UMAP_1 = mean(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = mean(UMAP_2))
  ) +
  facet_wrap( ~ name) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
metadata_df %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "sample_ID", pointsize = 2.1)
```

# SCTransform, Integrated


```{r}
so_integrated <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "so_immune_b_integrated.rds"), 
  function() {
    so_list <-
      subset(so_imm %>% set_idents("general_cluster_immune"),
             idents = c("B cell")) %>%
      SplitObject(split.by = "patient.clin")
    
    for (name in names(so_list)) {
      if (ncol(so_list[[name]]) < 100) {
        so_list[[name]] <- NULL
      }
    }
    
    so_list <- so_list %>%
      map(SCTransform)
    
    features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = so_list,
                                          nfeatures = 3000)
    so_list <-
      PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = so_list,
                         anchor.features = features)
    immune.anchors <-
      FindIntegrationAnchors(
        object.list = so_list,
        dims = 1:15,
        normalization.method = "SCT",
        anchor.features = features
      )
    so_integrated <- IntegrateData(
      anchorset = immune.anchors,
      normalization.method = "SCT",
      k.weight = 50
    )
    so_integrated <-
      run_seurat_rna_workflow(
        so_integrated,
        set_percentages = FALSE,
        run_normalize = FALSE,
        run_SCT = FALSE,
        dims = 1:30
      )
    so_integrated <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(so_integrated)
    return(so_integrated)
  }
)

```

```{r}
metadata_df <- so_integrated %>% 
  get_metadata_from_so()
```

### Markers res 0.5

```{r}
markers_res0.5 <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "dge_one.v.all_res0.5.rds"), 
  function() {
    FindAllMarkers(so_integrated %>% set_assay("SCT") %>% set_idents("integrated_snn_res.0.5"), 
                   assay = "SCT")
  } 
)
markers_res0.5_df <- markers_res0.5 %>% 
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
markers_res0.5_wide <- markers_res0.5_df %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, 
              names_from = cluster, 
              values_from = gene) %>% 
  {.[, c("rank", sort(as.character(colnames(.)[-1])))]}
datatable(markers_res0.5_wide)
```


```{r}
res0.5_key <- c(
  "0: Stressed", 
  "1: B cells", 
  "2: Proliferating", 
  "3: Plasma cells", 
  "4: Stressed", 
  "5: B/T doublets", 
  "6: Mito high", 
  "7: B cells", 
  "8: B cells"
) %>% 
  set_names(0:8)

metadata_to_add <- 
  get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated, metadata = "integrated_snn_res.0.5", reduction = NULL) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_B = res0.5_key[as.character(integrated_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
  mutate(general_clusters_B = case_when(
    clusters_B %>% str_detect("B cells") ~ "B cells", 
    clusters_B %>% str_detect("Plasma") ~ "Plasma", 
    clusters_B %>% str_detect("Proliferating") ~ "Proliferating", 
    clusters_B %>% str_detect("doublets") ~ "Doublets", 
    TRUE ~ "Stressed"
  )) %>% 
  select(-integrated_snn_res.0.5) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cell")
so_integrated <- AddMetaData(so_integrated, metadata = metadata_to_add)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "clusters_B", label = T, pointsize = 3.1)
get_metadata_from_so(so_integrated) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "general_clusters_B", label = T, pointsize = 3.1)
```

